author: Dr. Mayurakshi Katiyar
source: Dr. Hahnemann · Organon of Medicine, 6th ed

slides.title: Case-taking ke liye physician mein kya chahiye?
slides.quote: …freedom from prejudice and sound senses, attention in observing and fidelity in tracing the picture of the disease.
points: Har case ki individual examination: sirf general directions di hain, jo case par fit ho wahi lo
Freedom from prejudice: koi pehle se bani raay nahi
Sound senses: dekhna, sunna, observe karna theek ho
Attention in observing + fidelity: disease ki picture bilkul sach likho

slides.title: Patient ko bolne do, beech mein mat roko
slides.quote: Keeping silence himself he allows them to say all they have to say, and refrains from interrupting them…
points: 3 sources: patient (apni takleef), attendants (kya suna, kaisa behave kiya), physician (khud kya dekha/suna)
Sab kuch patient ke apne words mein likho
Physician chup rahe, roke tabhi jab baat topic se bhatke
Shuru mein bolo: dheere bolein, taaki likh sako
Footnote: interruption se train of thought toot jaati hai, wahi baat dobara waise nahi aati
slides.yaad: Patient + attendants + physician · own words · no interruption

slides.title: Har naya symptom, nayi line
slides.quote: He begins a fresh line with every new circumstance mentioned by the patient or his friends…
points: Har naye symptom/circumstance ke liye fresh line
Symptoms ek ke neeche ek, alag alag
Fayda: jo symptom pehle vague tha, baad mein detail milne par usi ke saath jod sakte ho
slides.yaad: 1 symptom = 1 line, neeche space for details

slides.title: Har symptom ko complete karo
slides.quote: …he reads over the symptoms as they were related to him one by one, and about each of them he inquires for further particulars…
points: Narration khatam hone ke baad, ek ek symptom padh kar wapas poochho
Kab: purani dawa se pehle, dawa ke dauraan, ya chhodne ke baad?
Kya sensation aur exactly kahan?
Fits mein ya continuous? Kitni der?
Din/raat ka kaunsa time, kaunsi position mein worse ya band
Har baat plain words mein describe karwao

slides.title: Leading questions bilkul nahi
slides.quote: …without ever framing his questions so as to suggest the answer to the patient, so that he shall only have to answer yes or no…
points: Detail poochho, par aisa sawaal nahi jo answer suggest kare
Yes/No wale sawaal avoid karo
Patient aalas mein ya doctor ko khush karne ke liye galat/aadha sach bol deta hai
Nateeja: false picture → galat treatment
Footnote: mat poochho 'Kya ye problem nahi thi?'
slides.yaad: Open questions only: no suggestion, no yes/no

slides.title: Jo parts/functions chhoot gaye, general sawaal se poochho
slides.quote: …he only makes use of general expressions, in order that his informants may be obliged to enter into special details…
points: Patient ne jo body parts, functions ya mind nahi bataya, uske baare mein poochho
Sawaal general rakho, taaki details patient khud de
Footnote examples: stool, urine, din-raat ki neend
Disposition, humour, memory · thirst, taste
Kya khana-peena pasand / napasand · khane ke baad kaisa lagta
Head, limbs, abdomen ke baare mein kuch?
slides.yaad: Gaps bharo, par general words mein

slides.title: Ab precise, special questions poochho
slides.quote: …the physician is at liberty and obliged… to ask more precise, more special questions.
points: Patient hi main source (feigned disease chhod kar); jab picture tolerably perfect ho jaaye, tab special questions
Stool, vomit, taste, eructation, urine: frequency, character, colour, sediment
Sleep: moan/talk/start? kis side? kapda odhna?
Modalities: sitting, lying, motion, fasting, morning, evening, after meal
Fever: chill, heat, sweat ka kram + thirst kab
6th ed: women mein menses aur discharges note karo
slides.yaad: Pehle patient ki apni kahani, phir specific details

slides.title: Physician ka apna observation
slides.quote: …he then makes a note of what he himself observes in the patient, and ascertains how much of that was peculiar to the patient in his healthy state.
points: Likhne ke baad, jo physician khud dekhta hai wo note karo
Check karo: kya ye healthy state mein bhi aisa tha?
Behaviour: morose, quarrelsome, weepy, anxious, calm…
Speech, face, eyes, skin colour · tongue, breath, smell
Pupils, pulse, abdomen, skin (moist/hot/cold/dry)
Position in bed: head back, mouth open, arms above head
slides.yaad: Patient ki story + physician ki observation = poori picture
